allow_unauthenticated.description: Allow provider initialization without login credentials. Intended for first-install bootstrap flows (for example creating the initial admin user when Dockhand auth is disabled). Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED`.

api_token.description: Dockhand API token for bearer-token auth. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_API_TOKEN`.

auth_provider.description: Auth provider id for login-based auth (e.g. `local`). Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_AUTH_PROVIDER`.

default_env.description: Default Dockhand environment ID sent as `env` query parameter when omitted by resources. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_DEFAULT_ENV`.

endpoint.description: Dockhand API base URL. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_ENDPOINT`. When this value is unknown during plan (for example when it references another resource's computed attribute), provider configuration is deferred until apply.

insecure.description: Disable TLS verification for API requests. Useful only for local development.

mfa_token.description: Optional MFA token for login-based auth. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_MFA_TOKEN`.

password.description: Dockhand password for login-based auth. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_PASSWORD`.

request_retry_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts for Dockhand login and API requests when transient connection failures occur. Defaults to `6`. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_REQUEST_RETRY_ATTEMPTS`.

request_retry_max_seconds.description: Maximum wait between retry attempts in seconds. Defaults to `5`. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_REQUEST_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS`.

request_retry_min_seconds.description: Minimum wait between retry attempts in seconds. Defaults to `1`. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_REQUEST_RETRY_MIN_SECONDS`.

username.description: Dockhand username for login-based auth. Can also be set with `DOCKHAND_USERNAME`.

block.description: Manages Dockhand authentication settings via `GET/PUT /api/auth/settings`.
Runs an async Dockhand batch operation via `/api/batch` and optionally waits for terminal job status via `/api/jobs/{jobId}`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

env_vars.description: Environment variables applied by the config set.

labels.description: Labels applied by the config set.

ports.description: Port mappings applied by the config set.

volumes.description: Volume mounts applied by the config set.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand Config Set via `/api/config-sets`.

cap_add.description: Linux capabilities to add at container create time.

command.description: Optional command string sent at container create time.

enabled.description: Desired runtime state. `true` starts container, `false` stops it.

env.description: Dockhand environment ID sent as the `env` query parameter.

env_vars.description: Environment variables map for create request.

nano_cpus.description: CPU quota in NanoCPUs (for example `500000000` = 0.5 CPU).

network_mode.description: Network mode for create request (for example `bridge`, `host`).

privileged.description: Whether to create the container in privileged mode.

restart_policy.description: Restart policy for create request (for example `no`, `unless-stopped`).

tty.description: Whether to allocate a TTY at create time.

update_payload_json.description: Optional raw JSON object sent to `/api/containers/{id}/update` after create and on updates. Use this to access advanced Dockhand update fields not yet modeled as first-class attributes.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand container using `/api/containers` endpoints.
Runs a one-shot container action (`start`, `stop`, `restart`, `pause`, `unpause`). Change `trigger` to run it again.
Runs a one-shot container update check via `/api/containers/check-updates`. Change `trigger` to run again.
Manages a file or directory inside a running container via Dockhand file APIs.
Runs a one-shot container rename via `/api/containers/{id}/rename`. Change `trigger` to run it again.
Runs a one-shot container update via `/api/containers/{id}/update` with a raw JSON payload object. Change `trigger` to run it again.

agent_token.description: Agent enrollment token for `connection_type = "agent"`. Provisioned through Dockhand Hawser token API.

ca_cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate for mTLS-enabled Docker API endpoints.

client_cert.description: PEM-encoded client certificate for mTLS-enabled Docker API endpoints.

client_key.description: PEM-encoded client private key for mTLS-enabled Docker API endpoints.

connection_type.description: Environment connection type. Example: `socket`. `agent` is mapped to Dockhand `hawser-edge`.

ensure_grype_installed.description: If true, ensures Grype scanner image is present by pulling `anchore/grype:latest` when missing.

ensure_trivy_installed.description: If true, ensures Trivy scanner image is present by pulling `aquasec/trivy:latest` when missing.

grype_installed.description: Whether Grype is currently available for this environment.

image_prune_cron.description: Cron schedule for automatic image pruning (Dockhand `/api/environments/{id}/image-prune`).

public_ip.description: Public IP address advertised for this environment. Defaults to an empty string when unset.

trivy_installed.description: Whether Trivy is currently available for this environment.

update_check_cron.description: Cron schedule for environment update checks (Dockhand `/api/environments/{id}/update-check`).

update_check_vulnerability_criteria.description: Vulnerability gating criteria for auto-updates (`never`, `critical`, etc.).

vulnerability_scanner.description: Scanner selection for this environment: `grype`, `trivy`, or `both`.

vulnerability_scanning_enabled.description: Enable vulnerability scanning for this environment (Dockhand `/api/settings/scanner` with env scope).

block.description: Manages a Dockhand environment via `/api/environments`.
Runs one-shot scanner operations for an environment: install/remove Grype or Trivy images, or check scanner updates. Change `trigger` to run again.

fail_on_error.description: If true (default), Terraform apply fails when Dockhand returns `success = false`.

name.description: Optional environment name label sent to Dockhand.

protocol.description: Docker API protocol (`http` or `https`) for direct connections.

tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate validation when testing HTTPS direct connections.

trigger.description: Arbitrary value that forces a new test run when changed.

block.description: Runs one-shot environment connectivity validation via `/api/environments/test`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

has_password.description: Whether Dockhand has a password/token stored for this credential.

has_ssh_key.description: Whether Dockhand has an SSH key stored for this credential.

ssh_key.description: SSH private key used for `auth_type = "ssh"`. Write-only.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand Git credential via `/api/git/credentials`.

credential_id.description: Optional Git credential ID to use for this repo.

environment_id.description: Optional Dockhand environment ID. Set to null to clear.

webhook_secret.description: Webhook secret generated by Dockhand, if enabled.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand Git repository integration via `/api/git/repositories`.

branch.description: Git branch to test when `url` is used.

compose_path.description: Optional compose path included in the test payload when `url` is used.

credential_id.description: Optional Dockhand Git credential ID to test with `url`.

fail_on_error.description: If true (default), apply fails when Dockhand returns `success = false`.

repository_id.description: Existing Dockhand Git repository ID to test. Mutually exclusive with `url`.

trigger.description: Arbitrary value that forces a new test run when changed.

url.description: Git clone URL to test when `repository_id` is not used.

block.description: Runs a one-shot Git repository connectivity test via `POST /api/git/repositories/test`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

build_on_deploy.description: Whether Dockhand should build images on deploy.

deploy_now.description: Whether to request immediate deployment when creating/updating this git stack.

env.description: Dockhand environment ID used as `env` query parameter.

force_redeploy.description: Whether Dockhand should force a redeploy on deploy.

repository_id.description: Existing Dockhand Git repository ID. If unset, `url` (and optional `repo_name`) are used.

repull_images.description: Whether Dockhand should repull images on deploy.

webhook_secret_auto_generate.description: When `true` and `webhook_enabled=true`, allow Dockhand to auto-generate a webhook secret if `webhook_secret` is not provided.

block.description: Manages Dockhand Git-backed stacks via `/api/git/stacks` in a target environment.
Runs a one-shot Git stack deploy request via `/api/git/stacks/{id}/deploy-stream`. Change `trigger` to run it again.
Reads env vars for a selected git stack env file via `/api/git/stacks/{id}/env-files`.
Triggers a one-shot git stack webhook call via `/api/git/stacks/{id}/webhook`. Change `trigger` to run again.

env.description: Optional environment ID. If omitted, provider `default_env` is used.

scan_after_pull.description: Whether to trigger vulnerability scanning during pull.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand image via `/api/images` pull/delete endpoints.
Runs a one-shot image push to a Dockhand registry. Change `trigger` to run it again.
Runs a one-shot image vulnerability scan via `/api/images/scan`. Change `trigger` to re-run.

active.description: Whether the current license is active.

hostname.description: Hostname the license is associated with, when provided by Dockhand.

key.description: License key used when setting/updating a license.

name.description: Licensee name used when setting/updating a license.

valid.description: Whether the current license is valid.

block.description: Manages Dockhand licensing via `/api/license`.

env.description: Optional environment ID. If omitted, provider `default_env` is used.

labels.description: Network labels returned by Dockhand inspect.

options.description: Driver options map used when creating the network.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand network via `/api/networks`.
Runs a one-shot network connect/disconnect action for a container. Change `trigger` to run it again.

event_types.description: Event types that will trigger this notification. If omitted, Dockhand's defaults are used on create and then stored in state on read.

smtp_skip_tls_verify.description: Whether to skip TLS certificate verification (optional when `type = "smtp"`).

smtp_use_tls.description: Whether to use implicit TLS (optional when `type = "smtp"`).

block.description: Manages a Dockhand notification integration via `/api/notifications`.

config_json.description: JSON object payload for `config` when `notification_id` is not used.

fail_on_error.description: If true (default), apply fails when Dockhand returns `success = false`.

notification_id.description: Existing Dockhand notification ID to use as test payload source.

trigger.description: Arbitrary value that forces a new test run when changed.

type.description: Notification type (`apprise` or `smtp`) when `notification_id` is not used.

block.description: Runs a one-shot notification test via `POST /api/notifications/test`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

env.description: Optional environment ID query parameter. If omitted, provider default env is used.

poll_interval_ms.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for async prune jobs.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds while polling async prune jobs.

trigger.description: Arbitrary value that forces a new prune run when changed.

wait_for_completion.description: Wait for terminal async job status when Dockhand returns `jobId`.

block.description: Runs one-shot prune cleanup actions via `/api/prune/*`. Change `trigger` to execute again.

has_credentials.description: Whether this registry currently has stored credentials in Dockhand.

is_default.description: Whether this registry is the default. Dockhand expects at most one default registry.

password.description: Registry password. Write-only. To clear stored credentials, set `username = ""` and `password = ""`.

username.description: Registry username. Set to an empty string along with `password` empty string to clear stored credentials.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand image registry via `/api/registries`.

fail_on_error.description: If true (default), apply fails when Dockhand returns non-2xx.

registry.description: Registry selector (ID or key expected by Dockhand `registry` query parameter).

trigger.description: Arbitrary value that forces a new action run when changed.

block.description: Runs one-shot remote registry image-tag delete via `DELETE /api/registry/image`. Change `trigger` to run again.

enabled.description: Desired enabled state (true = active, false = paused).

is_system.description: Whether this is a system schedule. If true, resource uses `/api/schedules/system/{id}/toggle`.

block.description: Manages pause/resume state of an existing Dockhand schedule using `/api/schedules/*/toggle`.
Runs a one-shot schedule execution via `/api/schedules/{type}/{id}/run`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

hide_system_jobs.description: Hide system jobs in schedule views.

block.description: Manages global schedule UI/settings via `GET/PUT /api/schedules/settings`.

primary_stack_location.description: Optional primary stack location. Set to `null` to clear.

block.description: Manages Dockhand general UI/settings via `GET/POST /api/settings/general`.

container_count.description: Current number of containers associated with the stack.

container_ids.description: Container IDs currently associated with the stack.

enabled.description: Whether the stack should be started after create and kept running.

env.description: Dockhand environment ID sent as the `env` query parameter.

id.description: Stack identifier in the format `<env>:<name>` or `<name>` when env is omitted.

status.description: Current stack runtime status as reported by Dockhand.

block.description: Manages a Dockhand stack using the documented /api/stacks endpoints.
Runs a one-shot stack action (`start`, `stop`, `restart`, or `down`). Change `trigger` to run it again.
Runs a one-shot stack adopt operation via `/api/stacks/adopt`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

block.description: Manages stack env content and secret variables via `/api/stacks/{name}/env` and `/api/stacks/{name}/env/raw`.
Runs a one-shot stack discovery scan via `/api/stacks/scan`. Change `trigger` to run it again.

is_admin.description: Whether this user is an admin.

mfa_enabled.description: Whether MFA is enabled for this user.
